title: OpenAI GPT–6 Astra breaks Enigma message that has resisted solution since 2005
summary: A Hacker News discussion about a claim that OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra solved the Mvueh Enigma cipher, an unsolved cryptogram from the Bletchley Park challenge that had resisted attack since 2005. Commenters debate the validity of the break, whether it reflects genuine reasoning versus pattern matching or memorization, and the implications for LLM capabilities in cryptanalysis.
